paragraphs: Veovo sells airport management software built around what it calls the Intelligent Airport Platform. The platform connects flight operations with passenger flow and uses real-time data and AI predictions for resourcing and capacity decisions. Its modular design is described as joining people, processes and information across the airport, with a view for every role.

Flight Management runs on a cloud hosted airport operational database. It automates data exchange with airport systems and industry data feeds, including IATA, Euro-control, AIDX, and Type B. Deployment is offered on premise or in the cloud, with SaaS or Managed Service options.

These pages describe the customers as airports and transport providers. A case study names Manchester Airports Group as a strategic partner for flow management technology. Another names Perth Airport, where a new operational system covers airline and ground handler flight management processes.

quote.text: Our Intelligent Airport Platform joins up data, predictions and decisions across landside and airside.
